gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.filter_: The resources this grid manages, and how many of each to keep on you.
gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.auto_in: Files surplus items from your inventory into storage while this grid is in your inventory. Never takes what you are holding, your armour, your offhand, or another grid.
gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.auto_ex: Tops the filtered resources back up to their amount out of storage. Reads the filter list whichever mode it is in, because topping up is a whitelist by nature.
gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.filter_: Auto-insert only files away the filtered resources, and only what you have beyond their amount.
Auto-insert files away everything except the filtered resources, which it leaves alone entirely.
